SMRTbell Library Construction utilizes the PacBio SMRTbell Prep Kit 3.0 (Pacific Biosciences, 102-141-700) and is fully automated on the STARlet liquid handler equipped with Hamilton filtered Tips 50 μL (Hamilton Company, 235948), Hamilton filtered Tips 300 μL (Hamilton Company, 235903), Hamilton filtered Tips 1000 μL (Hamilton Company, 235905), an Alpaqua magnet (Alpaqua SKU: A000400), 37°C heat block, 67°C heat block, shaker, and tube chiller. Master mixes were made and added to the tube chiller according to PacBio’s SMRTbell prep protocol. Perform a 1.0X volume over volume (v/v) of SMRTbell Cleanup Beads (Pacific Biosciences, 102-158-300) Add 110 μL of SMRTbell beads to the MIDI plate of sheared DNA. Shake for 30 seconds on the shaker block. Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature. Transfer the MIDI plate to an Alpaqua Magnet. Allow beads to separate until liquid is clear. Remove the supernatant. Add 200 μL of 80% Ethanol to the plate. Incubate for 30 seconds and remove. Repeat ethanol wash in steps 13g and 13h. Move the MIDI plate off the Alpaqua magnet. Add 47 μL of 1X Low TE buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, 0.1 mM EDTA, pH 8). Shake for 30 seconds on the shaker block. Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature. Transfer the MIDI plate to an Alpaqua Magnet. Allow beads to separate until sample is clear. Transfer eluate to a clear 96-well Plate (Eppendorf, 477-44-116). DNA Repair and A-Tailing Add 14 μL of DNA repair master mix (consisting of Repair buffer, End repair mix, DNA repair mix in a 4:2:1 ratio) to each DNA sample. Mix thoroughly using the 96-head. Move plate to the 37°C heat block. Incubate for 30 minutes. Move plate to the 65°C heat block. Incubate for 5 minutes. Adapter Ligation Add 4 μL of SMRTbell adapters from SMRTbell barcoded adapter plate 3.0 (PacBio 102-009-200) to each sample well. Add 31 μL of ligation master mix (consisting of ligation mix and ligation enhancer in a 30:1 ratio). Shake for 30 seconds on the shaker block. Incubate for 30 minutes at 20°C. 1X SMRTbell Bead Cleanup Perform a 1.0x v/v bead cleanup using a 40 μL final elution volume. Nuclease Treatment Add 10 μL of nuclease master mix (consisting of nuclease buffer and nuclease mix in a 1:1 ratio) was added to each sample well. Shake for 30 seconds on the shaker block. Incubate for 15 minutes at 37°C. Perform a 1.0x v/v bead cleanup using a 25 μL final elution volume of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 buffer. Transfer the SMRTbell libraries to a rack of matrix tubes (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 3744).

steps.title: DNA Volume Check and Quantification
steps.instruction: Verify that a minimum of 4 µg of DNA is available per SMRTbell Library Construction attempt.

substeps.instruction: Perform a volume check using a P200 pipette with wide-bore tips (Fisher Scientific, 21-236-1A).
Using an Agilent Bravo (G5509A) and 70μL tips (19133-102), transfer 3 μL aliquots of samples to Lunatic chips (Unchained Labs, 7012019).
Quantify DNA using the Lunatic UV/Vis Spectrometer (A260 dsDNA turbidity assay) to determine concentration and calculate total mass.

steps.title: Initial Fragment Analysis
steps.instruction: Evaluate the DNA fragment size distribution to ensure it meets long-read sequencing specifications.

substeps.instruction: Perform fragment analysis using the Agilent Genomic DNA 165 kb Kit (FP-1002-0275) on the Femto Pulse instrument (Agilent Technologies, M5330AA) per manufacturer instructions.
Conduct a smear analysis using ProSize software (v3.0; Agilent Technologies) to calculate the percentage of DNA fragments ≥ 40 kb.
Verify that ≥ 50% of DNA is > 40 kb; if not met, contact PacBio Tech Support.

steps.title: DNA Shearing
steps.instruction: Shear the DNA to the target size using a Megaruptor 3.

substeps.instruction: Using a STARlet liquid handler (Hamilton Company, 173000), transfer 4 µg of DNA in a volume of 110 µL into barcoded 0.5 mL shearing tubes (normalize with Low TE buffer if necessary).
Attach a hydropore 6 syringe assembly (Diagenode, E07010003) to each tube.
Load tubes onto the Megaruptor 3 (Diagenode, B06010003) and run with parameters: Concentration 49 ng/μL, Volume 100 μL, Speed 31.
Transfer samples from shearing tubes to a barcoded Abgene 96 Well 0.8 mL Polypropylene DeepWell plate.

steps.title: Post-Shear Size QC
steps.instruction: Verify the sheared DNA size using the Femto Pulse instrument.

substeps.instruction: Perform QC using the FemtoPulse Agilent Genomic DNA 165 kb Kit (FP-1002-0275) on the Femto Pulse instrument (Agilent Technologies, M5330AA) per manufacturer instructions.
Target shear size: 15-20 kb.

steps.title: SMRTbell Product Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the final SMRTbell products to determine if size selection is required.

substeps.instruction: Using an Agilent Bravo (G5509A) and 70 μL 384w Bravo Tips (19133-102), transfer 3 μL of SMRTbell products to a Lunatic plate (Unchained Labs, 701-2019).
In Lunatic software, select 'Nucleic Acids' -> 'A260 dsDNA (turbidity)' -> 'Lunatic plate'.
Name experiment, scan plate ID, highlight sample wells, choose appropriate blank, and start the run.
Analyze results: If ≥15 ng/µL, proceed to Size Selection; if <15 ng/µL, contact PacBio Tech Support.

steps.title: Size Selection via PippinHT
steps.instruction: Perform size selection on the SMRTbell libraries using the PippinHT system.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate PippinHT by covering LED detectors with manufacturer fixtures and running calibration.
Prepare PippinHT 0.75% agarose cassette (Sage Sciences, HPE7550): remove 150 μL buffer from upper chambers and elution wells and replace with fresh buffer; place a strip seal over elution wells.
Perform continuity test.
Using an Agilent Bravo (G5509A), add 25 μL of sample into sample wells and DNA ladder into the last cassette well.

Load cassette onto PippinHT (Sage Sciences, HTP0001) and run with settings: Cassette definition 6-10 kb High Pass Marker 75E, BPstart 10,000 bp, BPend 50,000 bp, Select 'Range', Run time 1 hour 20 minutes @ 75V.
Allow cassettes to rest at room temperature for 45 minutes.

steps.title: SMRTbell Library Recovery and Purification
steps.instruction: Recover size-selected DNA and perform a final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Using the Bravo, transfer 30 uL from elution wells into sample tubes.
Rinse elution wells with 30 uL of 0.1% Tween20 in low TE pH 8.0 (0.1% Tween 20, 10 mM Tris, 0.1 mM EDTA) and transfer to sample tubes; repeat once for a total volume of 90 uL.
Perform a final 1.0X v/v SMRTbell cleanup using 95 μL of SMRTBell Beads on the STARlet liquid handler.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification and Normalization
steps.instruction: Obtain final library concentration and normalize for loading.

substeps.instruction: Repeat 'Post SMRTbell Prep QC' steps to obtain final library quant.
Normalize samples to a loading concentration of 215-250pM using EB (10 mM Tris HCl pH 8.0) according to SMRTlink 'Sample Setup' recommendations.

steps.title: ABC Product Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the ABC product using the Revio polymerase kit.

substeps.instruction: Using a Hamilton STARlet and Revio polymerase kit (102-739-100), add 25 μL of annealing mastermix (1:1 ratio of sequencing primer and buffer) to each sample well; incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 1 μL of polymerase and 49 μL polymerase buffer to each sample; incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 120 μL of SMRTbell beads for 1.2X cleanup; incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Move plate to an Alpaqua magnet, separate beads, and remove supernatant.
Elute in 100 μL of Revio loading buffer; incubate for 5 minutes.
Move to Alpaqua magnet, separate beads, and transfer sample to a 96-well PCR plate (Eppendorf, 477-44-116).
Manually dilute Internal Control Complex (ICC) (PacBio, 103-508-800) and add to sample per PacBio guidelines.
Store final ABC product in the dark at +4°C for up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Revio Sequencer Loading
steps.instruction: Load the prepared ABC product onto the Revio sequencing plate.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Revio Sequencing plate (102-587-400).
Using the Bravo, transfer 95 μL ABC product into empty wells (A01-D01) of the plate.
Scan samples into the plate using the associated QR code card.
Manually seal sample wells with foil seals (Pacific Biosciences, 100-667-400).
Generate run design via SMRTlink software or CSV upload.
Load the Revio sequencer per manufacturer's protocol.
